title: misapplied-backfill-credits-to-incorrect-tenant-namespace
creator: Maya Chen
description: Several enterprise customers reported unexpected billing credits and negative usage adjustments after a scheduled backfill run for last-quarter metering. Credits were applied to tenants that did not own the corresponding API keys. This ticket drives the investigation, immediate mitigations, customer communications, and ledger reconciliation work. The scope spans Hosted + Dedicated + Private ingestion pipelines and the offline backfill job used during the usage ledger migration performed 2026-03-01.
reproduction_steps: Observe backfill job run in cron: jobs/usage-backfill-2026-03-01
Query ledger for tenant A and tenant B for 2026-01 to 2026-02 windows using /internal/ledger/query
Compare backfill delta events (namespace:backfill-v2) against raw ingestion logs in S3 prefix s3://redwood-metering/raw/2026-01
Attempt to replay backfill with --dry-run and mapping table used by the job (db:metering.shard_mapping)
Note: reproducing full misapplication requires running the actual backfill registry with original mapping; use sanitized test dataset to avoid new mischarges
investigation: 03-02 09:10 - PagerDuty triggered by billing-ops after 3 customer escalations (acct-549, acct-1183, acct-7722)
03-02 10:04 - Pulled backfill job logs from cloudstorage and discovered 17k credit events where tenant_id in ledger != tenant_id in original request payload
03-02 11:30 - Correlated with migration job that updated shard_mapping; mapping change deployed at 2026-02-28T23:47:12Z
03-02 14:20 - Noted that backfill job uses in-memory mapping snapshot at job start; concurrent mapping migration produced inconsistent mapping for some partitions
03-03 08:00 - Created and executed selective ledger rollback for affected backfill run window (backfill_run_id: bf-2026-03-01-01). Manual corrections staged in reconciliation table.
03-04 16:30 - Cross-checked against customer-subaccount metadata: some customers use nested namespaces (org > workspace) so naive hash-to-shard lookup damaged tenant attribution when mapping changed
root_cause: A data migration that changed shard_mapping for tenant namespace keys was applied during the backfill window. The backfill worker snapshots mapping at start but re-reads tenant metadata for certain joins; a race condition combined with inconsistent mapping format (old 2-field hash -> new 3-field hash) caused the job to resolve keys to incorrect tenant IDs for ~0.6% of events. Additionally, the backfill job lacked verification hooks to assert original API key -> tenant mapping before writing credits to the ledger.
mitigation:
Immediate actions taken:
- Stopped the scheduled backfill queue and paused any remaining backfill runs (03-02 12:05).
- Rolled back shard_mapping migration to the prior stable version (03-02 13:22) to prevent further misattribution.
- Executed a targeted compensation run that reversed the incorrectly applied credits and re-applied them to the correct tenants using canonical API key lookups (03-03 08:00 to 03-04 04:50).
- Issued provisional credits and an apology communication to impacted customers with clear reconciliation details (billing-ops ticket BOPS-7845).
temporary_workaround: For now, any migration to shard_mapping must be gated behind a migration window flag and a pre-check job that validates mapping equivalence on a per-partition basis. Backfill jobs must run with a verified immutable mapping snapshot stored in the job manifest and include a dry-run verification step that asserts tenant attribution counts against a checksum of original events.
follow_up_tasks: ENG-35790 - Add assertion and checksum step to usage-backfill worker to validate api_key -> tenant mapping before writing ledger entries
ENG-35791 - Add migration gating: deploy mapping change only when no active backfills reference affected partitions
ENG-35792 - Build a reconciliation job to compute per-tenant pre/post backfill diffs and flag >0.1% delta for manual review
ENG-35793 - Update runbook for backfill incidents and include customer communication templates
ENG-35794 - Add integration test that simulates mapping format changes across migration and backfill run concurrently
